story.intro: Everything here is something you said is true. Resumes and fit scores use only what you have confirmed.
story.waiting_one: 1 item is waiting for you to confirm it.
story.waiting_other: {{count}} items are waiting for you to confirm them.

empty.title: Your story is empty
empty.description: Add your resume in setup, or add a skill or achievement by hand.

answers.privacy: Jobgoblin fills in your contact details, pay and equal-opportunity answers itself. Claude never sees them.
answers.workAuthorizationHint: Whether you may work in each place, and what you will say when a form asks.
answers.eeoHint: Optional questions some forms ask. Decline to self-identify is a fine answer.

targets.rolesHint: One per line, for example Backend Engineer.
targets.maxYears: Most years of experience a job may ask for
targets.maxYearsHint: Jobs asking for more than this are left out. A job that asks for one or two more than your experience can still be worth trying.
targets.yearsError: Enter a whole number, zero or more.
targets.leaveOut: What to leave out or point out
targets.rolesToAvoidHint: One per line. A job with one of these words in its title is dropped before Claude reads it.
targets.hardSkipsHint: One per line. Claude skips any job that matches, whatever its score.
targets.flagsHint: One per line. Claude mentions them so you can decide. They never skip a job.

banned.title: Banned words
banned.description: Words or phrases that must never appear in a resume, an answer or your form details.
banned.label: Banned words
banned.hint: One per line. If a draft contains one, it is stopped and the word is named.
